summary: Ansible self-service automation portal 2.1.1 is GA with the AAP subscription, giving non-experts a point-and-click portal to launch job templates; it is deployed on OpenShift with a Helm chart (RHEL 10 planned as Tech Preview) and adds credential type labels, support link, feedback opt-out and label-based template sync skipping.
questions: How do I install the self-service automation portal?
Can I run the self-service automation portal on RHEL?
What is new in self-service automation portal 2.1.1?
How do I skip syncing a job template to the self-service portal?
